title: Russia Extends Producer Diesel Export Ban to Jan 31, 2027; Quotas to Serve US Deal
detail: Russia's Cabinet extended the producers' diesel export ban, due to expire Oct 31, until Jan 31, 2027. Sources told Reuters (via The Moscow Times) that quota-based exemptions would be used to fulfil the US deal, with November quotas reported at roughly 2-2.15 million tonnes versus about 0.5 million in October; the two outlets' figures differ slightly.

media.caption: Russia to extend diesel export ban, use quotas to fulfil US deal
